title.en: An Act to Amend Subsection (h), Section One Hundred Eighty-Five of Commonwealth Act Numbered Four Hundred Sixty-Six, Otherwise Known as the National Internal Revenue Code
title.orig: An Act to Amend Subsection (h), Section One Hundred Eighty-Five of Commonwealth Act Numbered Four Hundred Sixty-Six, Otherwise Known as the National Internal Revenue Code

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1960/ra_2662_1960.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Subsection h, Section one hundred eighty-five of Commonwealth Act Numbered Four hundred sixty-six, is amended to read as follows:
"(h) Firearms and cartridges or other forms of ammunition, except those locally manufactured: Provided, However, That no tax shall be collected on .22-caliber firearms and cartridges as well as other forms of ammunition sold or delivered directly to the Armed Forces of the Philippines or to any government instrumentality or agency as well as to any organization and persons engaged in maintaining peace and order for their use or issue."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1960.
